- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. content.text:
h07.

A browser requesting another user's avatar hits `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`, whose data is the base64 data-URI stored in the user table's `avatar_url` column. The hops from serving handler to the data layer:

- `RegisterRoutes` (route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` → handler) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124
- `serveUserAvatar` (serving handler) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168
- `getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
- `Store.GetUser` — store/user.go:148
- `Store.ListUsers` — store/user.go:136
- `s.driver.ListUsers` (interface dispatch to SQLite) — store/user.go:137
- `DB.ListUsers` (`SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user`, scans into `user.AvatarURL`) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88

The handler then decodes the stored value back to bytes and writes the response:
- `parseDataURI` (base64-decodes `user.AvatarURL`) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737, then `c.Blob(...)` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:209

Stored data = the `avatar_url` column of the `user` table (a `data:<mime>;base64,...` URI), selected at store/db/sqlite/user.go:159-164.
